“The Abbess” ~ C: Andy Cutting

A slow piece/air ~ a reliable source informed me this is a favourite at the session in Billinge, Lancashire. The transcription I’ve given here is from the playing of Andy Cutting:

“Old Light” / “The Abbess” - Andy Cutting
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k3XMGlbUYpI

& for other listens of this on YouTube, in other keys:

“The Abbess” - Sandy Shallis
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B1ytDwuTkeI

“The Abbess” - Roland Carson
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9RhDelNyUUM
